g.text: Third: maximum standard and advanced assignment points.These reflect the non-optional exercises’ stars.There are no advanced exercises in this file.
Fourth: Allowed Axioms lists permitted unproved assumptions.The source says functional_extensionality may appear;its meaning is covered in a later chapter.

Finally: a summary of which exercises are solved.The summary does not include the critical type-ok check.Read the earlier per-exercise report as well.Manual-grading entries still need a human evaluator.
